notes: Scrolling feels like the 0.11 build again, because it is the 0.11 build's scrolling. Qt moves a list about three lines of text per wheel notch and moves it instantly; the old build's code moves 135 pixels and glides there over 165 milliseconds, and compounds up to about half again when notches arrive quickly, so a fast flick travels further than a slow one. It also reads a touchpad's fine movements separately from a wheel's notches, and middle-click auto-scroll comes back with it. Home, Discover, Library, the airing calendar, downloads, settings, the detail page and the release list all use it.
